subject: Failed payment - authorization hold & retry request
messages:
From: Redwood Billing <billing@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Turner <aisha.turner@novasolutions.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment failed on invoice INV-4821 — authorization hold

Hi Aisha,

Our system attempted to collect payment for invoice INV-4821 (period ending 2026-06-30) this morning and the card on file returned an "authorization_hold" response from the card network — Stripe is marking this as a failed collection. The invoice is now past due and we flagged it for dunning retry per our policy.

Quick ask: could you confirm whether your Accounts Payable team placed an authorization hold on the corporate card (some European BINs do this for VAT verification)? If so, we'll hold off automatic retries and can send a VAT-broken-out invoice if that helps clear the hold.

Attached: INV-4821-EUR.pdf (tax breakdown) and the dunning log (stripe-dunning-log.txt).

If you prefer, I can temporarily open an exception to do an immediate one-time manual retry once you confirm the card is eligible. Let me know the contact and timing and I can coordinate with our payments ops.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Redwood Inference — Production-grade LLM inference for engineering teams
From: Aisha Turner <aisha.turner@novasolutions.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novasolutions Finance <finance@novasolutions.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 11:07:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Payment failed on invoice INV-4821 — authorization hold

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the heads up. Our payments team did indeed put a temporary authorization hold on the card last week while we sorted a VAT registration issue — it should be lifted once we provide a VAT-split invoice that lists the supplier VAT ID. Can you confirm Redwood's VAT ID and reissue the invoice with the breakdown on product lines (we need it to satisfy our AP process).

Also: is there a way to prevent the system from retrying and generating dunning notices? Those notifications trigger internal escalation on our end. If you can pause retries until we've confirmed, that would be ideal.

Best,
Aisha Turner
Head of Finance Operations
Nova Solutions Ltd.
aisha.turner@novasolutions.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Turner <aisha.turner@novasolutions.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment failed on invoice INV-4821 — authorization hold

On Sun, Jul 19, 2026 at 11:07 +0100, Aisha Turner wrote:
> Our payments team did indeed put a temporary authorization hold on the card last week while we sorted a VAT registration issue

Thanks for confirming, Aisha — we can absolutely pause retries. I'm looping in Marissa (Head of Revenue Ops) and Sergio (AE lead) to approve a one-off dunning exception and to reissue an invoice with Redwood's VAT ID and line-level tax.

Marissa / Sergio — can you approve a temporary pause on the automated retry schedule for Nova Solutions (deal_7642) until they confirm the hold is lifted? If approved, I'll request Payments to cancel scheduled retries and resend INV-4821 with the breakdown.

Diego
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment failed on invoice INV-4821 — authorization hold

Diego / Sergio,

Approved. I reviewed the dunning log and this looks like an authorization hold (network-level) rather than a decline. I'll open a dunning exception for Nova Solutions and flag Payments to skip the next two automatic retries.

Action items I'm logging now:
- Payments ops: cancel retries scheduled at 2026-07-20 and 2026-07-22 (I've added a support note).
- Finance: reissue INV-4821 with VAT ID and line-level tax breakdown; include supplier VAT ID: GB999888777.
- AE (Diego): confirm with Aisha once reissued and request card unblock timing.

I'll attach the support note to the invoice in the console when done.

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Turner <aisha.turner@novasolutions.com>, Novasolutions Finance <finance@novasolutions.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, Stripe Billing <billing@stripe.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 16:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment failed on invoice INV-4821 — authorization hold (Resolved)

Hi Aisha — quick update and resolution: thanks for the quick turn.

- Marissa approved a dunning exception and our Payments team paused the next two auto-retries.
- We reissued the invoice with Redwood VAT ID (GB999111222) and included a line-level tax breakdown; new invoice attached: INV-4821-EUR.pdf.
- Aisha confirmed with her AP team that the authorization hold was removed at 15:20 BST and they updated their card.
- Stripe reports the manual retry succeeded at 16:05 PDT and the payment is now posted. No chargeback or dispute was opened.

Action items closed. I'll leave the support ticket open for 48 hours in case anything else arises. If you need a copy of the proof-of-payment or remittance advice, tell me which email you prefer and I'll forward it.

Thanks for working with us on this — apologies for the friction.

Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: INV-4821-EUR.pdf
References: https://dashboard.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-4821
